Lava Launches New 'Smart 4 Plus' Smartphone in India

Indian smartphone manufacturer Lava has introduced a new device, the Smart 4 Plus, in India. Priced at ₹9,999, this launch marks the introduction of Lava's new 'Smart' smartphone series. The device is designed for budget buyers and features a Unisoc 9863A processor, 4 GB RAM, and 64 GB storage, running on Android 15 Go version with a promise of two years of security updates.
